item.title: Refactor order status to OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
In the orders crate, replace String-based order statuses with a proper public enum while preserving existing observable behavior.

Requirements:
- Add src/status.rs defining `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }`, deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash.
- Implement `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` with exactly `pending`, `paid`, `shipped`, `cancelled`; implement Display with the same output.
- Implement FromStr for OrderStatus with `type Err = ParseStatusError`. Define and publicly expose ParseStatusError; it must implement std::error::Error and its message must name the rejected input.
- Implement `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool`, allowing only pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, and paid->cancelled.
- Change `Order::status` to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from the crate root, and use OrderStatus everywhere so status string literals occur only in src/status.rs.
- Preserve existing observable behavior, including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing. Add/adjust tests as needed, and run `cargo test` successfully.
- Commit the completed work.
